title: PDO history gave no clear added six-month ENSO forecast skill in a 1980-2024 test
abstract: We tested whether PDO history adds six-month Nino 3.4 forecast skill beyond recent ENSO history. Separate fits for each starting month used only completed earlier targets. The test has 540 monthly origins in 1980-2024. Adding three PDO terms increased mean squared error by 5.52%. The conditional 95% five-year block interval for error reduction was -13.41% to +1.14%. Three other leads also gave negative point gains. Thus this test gives no clear added skill. It extends a prior March-to-winter campaign test across all starting months and several leads, using the same NOAA snapshots. It is not independent confirmation. Revised indices, few independent climate cycles, model form and conditional uncertainty limit inference. No physical North Pacific effect is excluded. Original code, aggregate evidence, an independent numerical audit and a figure support reproduction. Raw tables and monthly predictions stay outside the signed package.

display.caption: Added PDO history gives negative point skill at all four tested leads. Lines give conditional 95% five-year block intervals.
